question: What is the name of India’s proposed space station?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatiya Antariksh Station**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Bharatiya Antariksh Station (BAS)** is the official name of the planned modular space station to be constructed by India and operated by the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**.
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** formally announced the project in **October 2023**, setting a clear vision for India's presence in space.
 
• The primary timeline for the project involves launching the first module, known as **BAS-1**, by the year **2028**, with the complete station expected to be operational by **2035**.
 
• The station is designed to be placed in Lower Earth Orbit (LEO)</stron
